purpose: City-specific official registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry review.
assessment: Official Saltillo sources establish municipal cadastral services and a public city map that can locate/select parcels. The public documentation and viewer page do not expose an anonymous full polygon API or safe feature schema, so geometry remains unverified.
registryAssessment: The official Municipality of Saltillo describes the city Catastro office/e-Catastro and the Visor Saltillo as a public territorial viewer with property information and a parcel-selection flow. The viewer documents searching a property by address and clicking it to display information, with identity validation used for predial/account access. No anonymous polygon service schema or full parcel feature was verified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official city announcement identifies e-Catastro, a digital municipal cadastral workflow, and says Visor Urbano exposes territorial information including parcel information and location.

Official municipal Visor Saltillo is a public map viewer with a “Detalle del Lote” selection panel, city layers and Catastro services; its visible property-payment function is distinct from anonymous full-geometry access.
Official city guide says to locate a property by address in Visor Saltillo and select it for online predial payment; account access requires identity validation. No owner/account fields were entered.
Official city announcement describes the public Visor Saltillo territorial map developed with Catastro, Urban Development and Systems departments.
